edits.before: The CFTC application is a retrospective survivor-universe, economic-date replay.
edits.after: The CFTC application retrospectively evaluates forecasts for a survivor universe using downloaded economic dates.
edits.reason: Replace stacked compound modifiers with a complete sentence while retaining both retrospective economic dates and the survivor-universe limitation. The final wording makes forecasts the object of evaluation, rather than suggesting that dates themselves are replayed.
edits.intermediate_wording: The CFTC application retrospectively replays downloaded economic dates within a survivor universe.

edits.before: Ridge quantile regression links mature headroom to issue-known position states and calendar variables.
edits.after: Ridge quantile regression links completed headroom labels to issue-known position states and calendar variables.
edits.reason: Name the completed target labels explicitly, consistent with the mature-label eligibility condition.

edits.before: All standardization uses mature training observations.
edits.after: Standardization uses only training rows with completed labels.
edits.reason: Use the same completed-label terminology and preserve training-only standardization.
